name: 70422 · Amite, LA
findings: ZIP 70422 (Amite) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70422 (Amite) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70422 (Amite) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
